description: This PHP source file defines the EnforcePasswordDao class, which handles database operations related to enforced password requests within the OrangeHRM system's authentication module. It includes methods to save requests, retrieve them by reset code, and update their validity status.

classes.name: EnforcePasswordDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing enforced password request records in the database.

methods.name: saveEnforcedPasswordRequest
methods.description: Persists a new EnforcePasswordRequest entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEnforcedPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves an EnforcePasswordRequest entity based on a reset code, including associated user data, ensuring the user is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: updateEnforcedPasswordValid
methods.description: Updates the 'expired' status of a password enforcement request for a specified user.
